name: public-hygiene
description: Check public-facing text before it ships. leak-check finds internal-context leaks (local paths, run IDs, infra names, private provenance, dev-log narrative, unexpanded jargon) and sends high-stakes text to a fresh-context external-reviewer agent with a BLOCK/PASS verdict. cold-read finds context the audience lacks (terms nobody introduced, numbers without a base, unclear referents, unattributed quotes), applies separate standards to slides and documents, and asks the author for the missing facts.
